candidates.claim: The trunk on sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/24 allows VLAN 30 (CORP), which is outside its approved VLAN set {10,99}.
candidates.remediation: Remove VLAN 30 from the allowed VLAN list on sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/24 so that it carries only VLANs 10 and 99.

candidates.claim: The switchport trunk allowed list on sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/24 differs from the approved baseline: the baseline is VLANs 10,99 and the current configuration is VLANs 10,30,99.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change with the change record and revert the trunk allowed list to VLANs 10,99 unless adding VLAN 30 has been approved.
